verdict.rationale: Bruno is an offline, account-less API client. Comparable API clients can expose their own APIs with issuable keys, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Bruno consuming credentials (OAuth 2.0 client credentials, secret variables, vault integrations, Azure CLI auth), but nothing documents Bruno issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Those features are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
